# Lisa Malkie Vider (D): NYS Senate, District 9

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Lisa Malkie Vider's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://lisavider.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Patricia Canzoneri-Fitzpatrick](../canzoneri-fitzpatrick-patricia/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/vider-lisa> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A first-time candidate's biography plus a pitch about serving in the majority. The biography matches press profiles. Her health-spending statistic is roughly right only on one budget measure.

1. JNS's profile matches her Brooklyn upbringing, family and healthcare work.
2. Health care's share of the state budget depends on the measure: Medicaid is about 27–29% of state operating funds, while the Health Department's all-funds appropriation is about 43% of the budget.
